description_en: Queries the gateways in an edge instance
description_zh: 查询边缘实例中的网关
name: QueryEdgeInstanceGateway

parameters.help_en: The instance ID. This parameter is not required for public instances but is required for Enterprise Edition instances
parameters.help_zh: 实例ID。公共实例不传此参数，企业版实例需传入
parameters.name: iot_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The edge instance ID. You can obtain the ID by moving the pointer over the name of the target edge instance on the Edge Instances page in the Link IoT Edge console (https://iot.console.aliyun.com/le/instance/list).

You can also call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/135214.html operation to obtain the ID
parameters.help_zh:
边缘实例ID。在边缘计算控制台 (https://iot.console.aliyun.com/le/instance/list)的边缘实例页面中，鼠标悬浮在目标边缘实例名称上获取ID。

您也可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/135214.html接口获取
parameters.name: instance_id

Code.description_en: The response code. A value of Success indicates that the call was successful. Other values indicate error codes. For more information, see [Error codes]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/135200.html）
Code.description_zh: 接口返回码。Success表示成功，其它表示错误码。详情请参见[错误码]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/135200.html）

ErrorMessage.description_en: The error message returned if the call fails
ErrorMessage.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回的出错信息

GatewayList.description_en: The gateway data returned if the call is successful
GatewayList.description_zh: 调用成功时，返回的网关数据

DeviceName.description_en: The name of the gateway device

EdgeVersion.description_en: The version of the edge service

IotId.description_en: The ID of the gateway device. The IoT ID is the unique identifier generated by IoT Platform for the device
IotId.description_zh: 网关设备的ID，物联网平台为设备生成的唯一标识符

ProductKey.description_en: The ProductKey of the product to which the gateway belongs. The ProductKey is the unique identifier of the product
ProductKey.description_zh: 网关所属产品的Key，产品的唯一标识符

RequestId.description_en: The unique identifier generated by Alibaba Cloud for the request
RequestId.description_zh: 阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the call was successful. Valid values:
true: The call was successful.
false: The call failed
Success.description_zh: 表示是否调用成功。true表示调用成功，false表示调用失败
